author: Peter Kugelmann
tagline: A research programme in which geometric structure is asked to explain physical observables.

home.eyebrow: A geometry-first approach to fundamental physics
home.headline: Can the structure of nature emerge from geometry?
home.lead: Born–Hopf Geometry investigates whether a compact, internally constrained geometry can account for the architecture of quantum physics, particles, interactions and cosmology. It is a mathematical research framework with testable ambitions—not a claim that every physical bridge has already been established.

concepts.title: A compact starting point
concepts.text: The three-sphere S³ is not an ordinary ball in space. It is a compact three-dimensional geometry, closely related to rotations and unit quaternions. Its symmetries provide a structured starting point rather than an unbounded continuum of arbitrary choices.

concepts.title: Position and momentum together
concepts.text: The framework studies a reciprocal eight-dimensional geometry M₈ built from paired position-like and momentum-like sectors. Their relations, phases and operators are used to formulate physical kinematics.

concepts.title: Observable consequences
concepts.text: Finite geometry is only the beginning. A particle mass, decay width or gravitational coupling must follow from an action, a realized source and a map to a measurable quantity—not merely from a suggestive number.

path.title: Constitution
path.text: What geometric structure can be physically distinguished?

path.title: Symmetry and carriers
path.text: What states and operators can the geometry support?

path.title: Dynamics
path.text: Which states and transitions are generated by an action?

path.title: Physical tests
path.text: Which measured quantities follow, and what remains conditional?

home.closing_title: An explanation should reach a measurement.
home.closing_text: A geometric analogy is not a physical prediction. The research program treats source occurrence, dynamical evolution, a detector-facing readout and independent comparison as separate obligations. The papers and proof-chain records are available so that each step can be examined.
home.status_text: The manuscript series contains exact mathematical constructions, conditional physical statements and open links to measurement. In the latest supplied corpus, actual charged-source realization, interacting particle poles and the microscopic identification of the gravitational action remain unresolved. See the latest source notes and verification reports for the precise scope.
